subject: Don't suppress error when running python integration tests. (#89)
reason: The change modifies only testing/integration/CMakeLists.txt, removing OUTPUT_QUIET/ERROR_QUIET from execute_process calls so pip/venv setup errors are no longer suppressed during CMake configuration of the python integration tests (plus a trailing-newline fix). It is a build/CI change with no effect on the valkey-search module binary, its commands, replies, indexing, or any server behaviour, so no scenario can reach it and none is needed.
